events.title: Demo update v0.2.2: easier first steps and a capture tutorial fix
events.summary: Hi everyone! Thank you to everyone who played the demo or commented on the trailer. Many of you said it wasn't clear what you're supposed to do, and some thought they had to steer every goblin by hand. This update only changes text and menus, so your first run is easier to follow. Battle numbers are unchanged, and your saves still work. Fixes Capture tutorial: the first time you met "An electrifying slug", its dialogue didn't play and capturing wasn't unlocked, so the slug just got knocked out.

events.title: New trailer + new demo: Goblin Electric Ltd. goes on expedition
events.summary: Hi everyone! Goblin Electric Ltd. is down to two employees and one very old generator. The plan: hire every goblin who'll work for scrap, march into the Abandoned Power Valley and bring home a giant monster. Alive. Then plug it into the grid. To everyone who played our earlier demo Thank you! In that demo, a small crew roped up creatures and hauled them home before dark. events.title: Welcome to Goblin Electric Ltd. — The Steam Page Is Live!
events.summary: Welcome to Goblin Electric Ltd. Our Steam page is now live. This is the first public stop for the project, and we are excited to finally show you the factory, its creatures, and the extremely questionable company responsible for keeping the lights on. Goblin Electric Ltd. is a fast single-player 3D arcade-strategy roguelite.
